summary: RC1 sign-off UI validation for SONGRIGHT. Auth (login/register/logout), protected route redirects, session creation, 12-tab studio, Lyrics editor, Song DNA, Release dashboard, Song Intelligence + share link + public /report/:token, Creator Passport, Connected Services (search + category filter + Manage dialog + audit log), Ownership Dashboard, Overview 10-milestone Song Journey, Mobile (375x812) responsive checks — all functionally rendered. Two findings block a clean sign-off: (1) uncaught clipboard exception on Share dialog crashes React error overlay, (2) five sidebar entries in the Studio left rail are dead links.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Generate share link' triggers an uncaught 'NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied' that surfaces the React dev error overlay. The share link IS created server-side and the public /report/:token page opens correctly, but the user sees a full-screen red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay in preview environments. Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch and fall back to selectable text.

Five sidebar entries are rendered as non-navigable divs (to: null): Collaborators, Rights Center, Publishing, Analytics, Templates. Review explicitly requires 'Sidebar links ... all resolve to real routes with no dead links.'
After creating a session, user is navigated to /sessions/:id (session detail) instead of /sessions/:id/studio (studio workspace) as specified in the review request.

rca of the issue: Share dialog crash: SongIntelligence generates the share link successfully via POST /sessions/:id/share, then attempts navigator.clipboard.writeText(link). In preview/headless contexts (and any browser where clipboard-write permission is not granted or the doc is not focused), writeText rejects with NotAllowedError. Because the promise rejection is not caught, React's error boundary/dev overlay surfaces the exception. Fix: `try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link); toast('Copied'); } catch { toast('Copy failed — link shown below'); }` and show the link in a selectable read-only input. Studio sidebar dead links: intentional placeholders authored with to:null in StudioSession.jsx should either be routed to existing pages (/sessions for Collaborators; /settings/integrations for Publishing; /vaulta or /profile fallbacks) or removed from the sidebar until routes exist. Given feature-freeze, safest change is to hide these entries or make them non-interactive with visible 'coming soon' affordance.
